rationale: Adobe explicitly frames services as 'licensed, not sold' (1.2), but this critical distinction is buried in dense legal language after an opening paragraph emphasizing content ownership, creating moderate deception. Multiple aggressive provisions—forced individual arbitration (15.3), unilateral termination at will (11.2), automatic content deletion after 30 days (3.3), and broad liability disclaimers—significantly worsen the consumer position.
